The objective 32 was to minimize peak magnetic flux in conventional transformers using the fewest devices. Both globalandlocalLQRcontrols,aswellasdecentralizedHamiltonian-basedcontrols,wereapplied. Optimal SST placements for a 15-transformer grid, see Fig. 3-18, are shown in Table 3-2, and optimal H-SST placements in Table 3-2. In the tables, the rows of the tables show the results for different SST or H-SST placements. The first 15 columns show whether a SST or H-SST was placed, the 16th colunm shows the worst flux in all transformers during a CM insult, and the last column shows the total number of transformers replaced in the system. In both cases, worst-case flux levels in conventional transformers were reduced below 1.2 p.u. with only six or seven SST replacements or H-SST modifications. This means that the whole system can be protected with underhalfthetransformersreplaced. Overall,SSTsandH-SSTscancoordinateatthesystemleveltodirectHEMP-inducedcurrentsaway from conventional units.
